description: Office of the Public Service Commission - Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Teacher Educators' Service - 3rd Amendment
categorisation: This gazette notification contains amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Teacher Educators Service, which relates to public service recruitment, qualifications, and service conditions. It is issued by the Public Service Commission and deals with administrative regulations for public sector employees (teacher educators), making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8). While it involves government administrative matters, it does not focus on government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed ministerial portfolios that would fall under Types 1-3.
